data.name: Jahah
data.gender_notes: Jahah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the root letters J-H-H, which mean 'to be sublime, great, or glorious'. The name Jahah carries the meaning “Majestic, Glorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jahah usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, glorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reminds us of the divine presence of Allah in our lives and the blessings we receive from Him.
data.etymology: Jahah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, Glorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jahah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: جاه
in_arabic.meaning: الجاه تعني الشخصية أو الهيبة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الجاه مشتق من الجذر العربي ج-ه-ه، والذي يعني الهيبة أو الشخصية. في اللغة العربية، الجاه هو مصدر للفخر والاعتزاز، ويرتبط بالشرف والكرامة. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفتح، الآية 18، حيث قال الله تعالى: 'ويضيف إلينا جاهاً في الدنيا'، مما يدل على أهمية الجاه في الحياة الدنيا.

in_urdu.name: جاہ
in_urdu.meaning: جاہ کا مطلب ہے وقار یا عزت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام جاہ عربی جذر ج-ه-ه سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وقار یا عزت. اردو میں، جاہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو احترام اور شان کے احساس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے. جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے لئے، جاہ ایک مقبول نام ہے جو اچھے کردار اور ساکھ کی اہمیت کو یاد دلاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: جاه
in_hindi.meaning: جاه का अर्थ है गरिमा या सम्मान
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम जाह अरबी मूल ज-ह-ह से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है गरिमा या सम्मान. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, जाह एक ऐसा नाम है जो अच्छे चरित्र और प्रतिष्ठा के महत्व को दर्शाता है. यह नाम भगवान की कृपा और आशीर्वाद के प्रतीक के रूप में भी देखा जाता है.

in_pashto.name: جاہ
in_pashto.meaning: جاہ د عزت او شان معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د جاه نوم د عربی جذر ج-ه-ه څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د عزت یا شان معنی لري. په پښتني کلتور کې، جاه داسې نوم دی چې د ښه کرکټر او ساکې د اهمیت په یادګار دی. دا نوم د الهي د فضل او برکت د نښه په توګه هم لیدل کیږي.

in_english.name: Jahah
in_english.meaning: Jahah means dignity, honor, or prestige in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jahah originates from the Arabic root ج-ه-ه (jahaha), which means to have dignity, honor, or prestige. In Islamic tradition, Jahah is considered a name that reflects good character and reputation. The name is mentioned in the Quranic context, emphasizing the importance of maintaining dignity and honor in life. Historically, Jahah has been used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing respect, nobility, and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jahah is not a widely used Islamic name. However, the root letters J-H-H have deep significance in Islam, as they are found in numerous compound words expressing attributes of Allah (God) such as Jalil (Majestic), Jameel (Beautiful), and Huwa (He). Therefore, this name carries the cultural impression of a connection to the divine presence of Allah, creating a sense of religiousness and reverence.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the Islamic name Jahah signifies the belief that all of life is an expression of Allah's sublime and all-encompassing presence. By carrying this name, the individual is reminded to constantly remember and reflect upon the profound nature of existence, as every aspect of daily life is an opportunity to seek and connect with the divine. This name is a reminder to believe in the greatness and glory of Allah, and to strive towards living in accordance with His beautiful and magnificent character.
